operation.summary: Whether the remaining-useful-life relay is open, and its limits (any signed-in account)
operation.description: Read only. It tells a client whether the relay of the estimate (`POST /api/ai/anomaly-detector/rul`) is open to operators (`rul.enabled`, off by default) and how large a request it accepts, so the card of the AI dashboard shows itself only when the server has the option on. It answers exactly the three fields of `RulConfig`, with `Cache-Control: no-store`. It is fail-closed: a configuration that is missing or cannot be read gives `enabled` false with the default limits (5000 points, 8000 ms) instead of an error. A server that predates the route answers `404`, which a client reads as closed.

200.description: The switch and the limits of the relay.
